context:
Evaluating a Coralogix support response for this user question:

After adding gen_ai spans, 100 bare invoke_agent spans with conversation id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001 appeared on the tenant. What happened and how do I prove it's fixed?

checklist.name: test-suite-exported
checklist.description: Identifies the test suite as the source (a Settings class read a .env carrying the export switch on, and the all-zero id is a fixture) and forces export off in the test environment.

checklist.name: proof-by-tenant-query
checklist.description: Proves the fix by running the suite and querying the tenant for spans of this application in that window, expecting an empty result, rather than by reading a code default.

checklist.name: no-blame-elsewhere
checklist.description: Does not attribute the spans to another developer, an earlier attempt or the environment, and does not dismiss them as noise. FAIL if it does.
